payload.kickoff_note: kickoff ~1h after lock per user; schedule sources conflicted (ESPN said Jul 2 PT evening, TechRadar Jul 3 EST) — user statement wins

adjustment_reasons: +10: Amoura (Algeria's in-form forward) injured, unlikely to start — small because he already missed the Jordan and Austria games, so recent Elo movement partly reflects Algeria without him
0: Switzerland fully fit (Widmer back in training); Manzambi start-or-bench is selection, not availability
0: BC Place roofed, neutral, both sides ~6 days rest

basis: single mechanism, single direction (ESP-AUT lesson: no double hedge): cross-confederation Elo uncertainty. AUS-EGY pilot showed the market's implied rating of a CAF side ~90 Elo above eloratings' relative view; UEFA-CAF links are thin
partial weight (-34 on d_eff, ~40% of the AUS-EGY inversion) because Algeria's Elo has ALREADY surged (+81/+144 over recent windows) — the system partly caught their rise, unlike Egypt's case
player-quality check supports the shade: Mahrez/Ait-Nouri/Gouiri/Aouar/Bentaleb is premium-league core comparable to Switzerland's (Kobel/Akanji/Xhaka/Embolo)
no extra draw bump, no style hedge: J = M curve evaluated at d=105, nothing else

rationale: Elo +129 raw: solid but not crushing favorite; Switzerland topped group (4-1 BIH, 2-1 CAN, 1-1 QAT), Algeria third in J via 3-3 Austria
defense contrast mild: CH conceded 3 in 3; DZ conceded 3 to Austria alone in the chaos game
invalidation: Amoura declared fit and starts -> amend -10
Mahrez or Gouiri missing from announced XI -> amend toward CH
Manzambi starting does not trigger amendment (selection variance, already in rating)
